marketplace.name: skill-market
marketplace.description: Marketplace for managing Claude, Codex, and Grok skills and plugins through local inventory, catalog discovery, lifecycle commands, and pull-request proposals.

packages.name: skill-market-claude
packages.description: Use this Claude plugin to list local Skill Market inventory, discover catalog packages, download, install, update, enable, disable, uninstall, and propose catalog changes through pull requests.

packages.name: implementation-planning
packages.description: Use Claude to plan specific changes using applicable project constraints, with verifiable tasks, dependencies, acceptance, handoffs and archives.

packages.name: project-bootstrap
packages.description: Use Claude to establish runnable project foundations and refactor architecture for AI-led development, with lasting engineering conventions recorded in the project.
